data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'χάρις' (charis) meaning 'grace, kindness, or mercy'. In Christianity, this name signifies God's divine favor and blessings. The name Bannasch carries the meaning “God's grace, mercy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bannasch usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
